title: Meetings & Travel Specialist
description:
Title:

Meetings & Travel Specialist

KBR is a global leader in delivering technology-driven, mission-critical, and sustainable solutions that truly matter. For over a century, we have powered bold missions across defense, space, industry, and government through our two core business lines Mission Technology Solutions and Sustainable Technology Solutions. With nearly 38,000 talented people operating in more than 80 countries, we thrive on a culture built on safety, integrity, and teamwork. At KBR, we empower our people to solve the world’s toughest challenges and create lasting value for communities and the planet. We don’t just deliver results, we deliver game-changing solutions, innovative technology, deep domain expertise, and cutting-edge technologies.

KBR is seeking a Meetings & Travel Specialist in Houston, Texas to join our Global Travel Services team. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing corporate meetings, events, and travel-related initiatives while ensuring exceptional service, budget stewardship, and policy compliance. The position also supports KBR's corporate travel program and serves as a key administrator of the company's preferred global hotel program. The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, and experienced in corporate meetings, event management, and travel operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and coordinate corporate meetings, conferences, team events, private dining events, training sessions, and other company-sponsored programs.
  • Manage event logistics, including venue selection, room blocks, catering, audiovisual services, transportation, and attendee communications.
  • Partner with sourcing providers and hotels to secure meeting space, negotiate terms, and obtain competitive pricing.
  • Support contract administration activities in accordance with company procurement and legal requirements.
  • Manage event registration processes and attendee tracking activities.
  • Develop event budgets, forecasts, reconciliations, and post-event reporting.
  • Conduct venue research, site evaluations, and supplier assessments.
  • Provide onsite event support and coordination when required.
  • Administer Meeting Card documentation, expense reconciliation, and charge code allocation processes.
  • Coordinate rooming lists and hotel reservations through preferred travel management providers.
  • Process event-related payment requests and supplier invoices.
  • Lead administration of the company’s preferred global hotel program, including hotel participation, traveler communication, and program reporting.
  • Support day-to-day corporate travel program activities and assist the Global Travel Manager with special projects and initiatives.
  • Maintain supplier relationships and assist with supplier performance reviews.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, cost savings, and enhanced service delivery.
  • Maintain accurate event, contract, invoice, and travel program records.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, Tourism, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in corporate meetings, event planning, hospitality, travel management, or related disciplines.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience working directly with suppliers, hotels, travel providers, or event management organizations.

Professional Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organizational and project management capabilities.
  • Excellent customer service and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively negotiate and manage supplier relationships.
  • Financial and analytical skills, including budget tracking and reconciliation support.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality execution.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) certification or progress toward certification.
  • Experience supporting global travel programs or corporate travel operations.
  • Experience negotiating hotel and meeting contracts.
  • Experience administering event registration platforms and attendee management systems.
  • Familiarity with Concur, Cvent, or similar travel and event management technologies.

Additional Compensation: KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Benefits: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

description:

title: Manager, Corporate Network Engineering
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Corporate Network Engineering team owns Anthropic's corporate network: the wired, wireless, and edge infrastructure in our offices and research facilities around the world, and the standards, management systems, and telemetry that let a small team run them. We hold that network to the bar of a production service — designed for failure, managed as code, observable end-to-end, and secure by default — while delivering reliable connectivity to the people who depend on it every day.

You'll set the technical direction together with your engineers and own the final decision on it and on the architecture standards, review and guide designs and the hard trade-offs, and lead vendor and platform decisions. You'll lead and grow a small team of network engineers: set priorities, drive decisions to closure, hire, and develop people. The team is small and the scope is broad, so this role needs real depth in campus and edge networking, judgment about what to standardize, automate, buy, and build, and the range to go from a wiring-closet decision to a budget defense in the same afternoon.

You'll report to the head of IT Engineering and partner closely with our Buildouts, AV, and Endpoint teams; with Security Engineering on network security, authentication, and detections; with Physical Security, whose systems are critical for protecting Anthropic employees and depend on a reliable network; with Workplace, Real Estate, Procurement, and external logistics and integration partners on new site buildouts; and with our production networking teams, whose bar for reliability and automation is the one we hold ourselves to. Your work will directly shape how we scale to AI Safety Level 4 and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow the Corporate Network Engineering team — hiring, development, performance, planning, and prioritization
  • Set technical direction with the team and own the final call on architecture standards across edge, campus switching, wireless, segmentation, out-of-band management, and telemetry; review designs and risky changes, and step in on the hard problems
  • Own reliability and operations: monitoring people act on, incident response and post-incident reviews that produce changes, an on-call and escalation model a small team can sustain, change safety, and lifecycle currency
  • Move the fleet toward network-as-code: templated configuration with change control, staged rollouts, drift detection, and automation that removes operational toil
  • Partner with Security Engineering and Detection & Response on network authentication, segmentation, and the network as a detection source
  • Deliver networks for new offices and research facilities and upgrade existing sites through live migrations — with Buildouts, AV, Physical Security, Workplace, Real Estate, and our logistics partners — while keeping interruptions to employees minimal
  • Own vendor, carrier, and integrator relationships and the network hardware budget: evaluations, contracts, lead times, and multi-year refresh

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have 10+ years designing, building, and operating enterprise campus and edge networks, including at least one environment with dozens of sites across regions
  • Have 5+ years leading engineers, including at least 3 years as a people manager
  • Lead through technical judgment: whether or not you've been hands-on-keyboard lately, you can go from architecture to protocol behavior to failure modes with your engineers, and your reviews make their designs better
  • Default to the secure design, then do the creative work to make it painless for the people using it — and can walk an executive or an engineer through the trade-off and make a recommendation
  • Have run the operational side, not just designed it: out-of-band access, monitoring people act on, an on-call model a small team can sustain, and change safety
  • Are pragmatic about what to build, buy, or automate, have run vendor evaluations with real money at stake, and chase problems across organizational boundaries to the actual root cause
  • Communicate clearly with engineers, executives, contractors, and landlords, and can bring a room of senior engineers with strong opinions to a decision they'll commit to
  • Want real technical ownership with a small team — including if you've led a larger organization before — and care about building infrastructure for an organization trying to get AI right

Strong candidates may also

  • Have led corporate networking at a company that added offices faster than it added network engineers
  • Have implemented certificate-based network authentication (802.1X/EAP-TLS or equivalent) and identity- or device-based segmentation at scale
  • Have shipped network configuration as code and built telemetry pipelines that security and support teams actually use
  • Have designed dense wireless for large event spaces and high-occupancy floors
  • Have been through multiple office builds with real estate and construction teams — including networks that physical security systems depend on — and know what to ask for before the walls close
  • Have managed integrators, MSPs, or smart-hands providers as an extension of a small team while keeping design authority in-house

Technical Skills

We're looking for deep, hands-on experience in each of these — not surface familiarity:

  • Enterprise edge: firewalls and routing (HA design, routing protocols, policy management across a fleet)
  • Campus switching and high-density enterprise wireless (L2/L3 design, redundancy, RF design, 6 GHz, high-density venues)
  • Segmentation and access control (certificate-based 802.1X, dynamic segmentation, guest and IoT isolation)
  • Out-of-band management and secure, auditable administrative access
  • Network automation and configuration as code (Python, templating, vendor APIs, source control, CI)
  • Network observability (streaming telemetry, flow and log pipelines)
  • Physical infrastructure for buildouts (MDF/IDF design, structured cabling, power and cooling, carrier and path diversity)

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$285,000—$325,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Loan Coordinator-396
description:
Under the supervision of the Mortgage Banking Operations Processing Manager, this position is responsible for coordinating all applicable residential loan documentation to complete a residential loan transaction pursuant to guidelines as set forth by Bank of Hawaii and secondary marketing investor requirements, from application to submission to underwriter for final approval. Ensures processing of loans within specified timeframes.

  • Gathers and reviews all income, asset, credit, title, property information and disclosures in a residential loan transaction for all loans including: Validates the information on the loan application and findings of the respective underwriting engine, pursuant to the bank and secondary requirements. Reviews all loan information, including, but not limited to credit reports, appraisal reports, tax returns, financial statements, income, and asset documentation. Calculates all income being used to qualify.
  • Processes documents pursuant to investor, bank and regulatory guidelines. Ensures the integrity and consistency of data in the loan file and on the loan origination/processing system.
  • Maintains productivity and quality of service standards, as established by Management, with respect to the approval of loans, including but not limited to submission of loan to underwriter for approval within specified timeframes, from the receipt of Intent to Proceed signed by the borrower for initial credit approval to final approval, pursuant to standards set forth by Management. Validates all point of sale income and asset documents with the information on 1003 and automated underwriting findings. Ability to process and manage a pipeline of 50 files. title: Client Service Coordinator
description:
Client Service Coordinator
The person who keeps client communication, documents, and next steps moving.
Position: Full-time, non-exempt, 40 hours per weekWork location: Remote with optional in-office access for Seattle-area employeesTeam: Tax Department AdministrationSalary: $58,000-68,000 depending upon experience

About R.D. Barnett PLLC

R.D. Barnett PLLC is a growing accounting, tax, and advisory firm. Accounting, tax, and advisory services are the heart of our business, but relationships are our lifeblood. We listen, ask questions, customize solutions, and care about outcomes. We are also a technology-forward firm that uses modern systems, automation, and AI tools to improve the client and employee experience.

Position Overview

The Client Service Coordinator is the traffic controller for the client journey. This person coordinates communication, documents, deadlines, and handoffs between clients and our professionals so clients always know what is needed, what happens next, and who is responsible. The role owns the daily execution of nontechnical client-service workflows across tax, accounting, and advisory engagements.

Important role boundary: This position does not answer tax-specific questions or make technical tax determinations. No prior tax knowledge is required. The coordinator gathers facts, provides administrative guidance, and routes technical questions to the appropriate professional.

What You Will Own

Client Communication and Triage

  • Serve as a responsive, welcoming point of contact for client and prospect questions related to systems, document receipt, & general process questions.
  • Monitor assigned shared inboxes, client portals, and incoming requests; acknowledge receipt, clarify what is needed, and route each item to the right person.
  • Help clients use firm-supported systems, portals, document uploads, access codes, and electronic signatures.
  • Conduct scripted introductory calls with prospective clients, gather nontechnical background information, explain the firm's process, and coordinate next steps for scoping. Provide support to the Business Development efforts with follow up on proposals, scoping documents, and proposal generation.
  • Communicate proactively when an answer or deliverable is still in progress so clients are never left wondering whether their request was received.

Onboarding, Offboarding, and Engagement Administration

  • Coordinate onboarding for new, re-engaging, and established clients, including client records, contacts, access, permissions, project setup, and internal handoffs.
  • Draft and coordinate engagement letters, proposals, and related client agreements using approved scopes and pricing; track completion and escalate stalled items.
  • Coordinate required offshore-consent documentation and maintain accurate completion records.
  • Manage client offboarding and disengagement workflows, including records, access, communication steps, and internal notifications.

Tax-Season Client Coordination

  • Prepare and send organizers, questionnaires, document requests, and reminders through the firm's approved systems.
  • Review, file, and organize client-uploaded information; identify incomplete submissions, acknowledge receipt, notify the appropriate team, and update the related project or tracker.
  • Create and maintain client binders and other administrative workpapers in accordance with documented procedures.
  • Follow up on missing information, signatures, engagement letters, organizer completion, and other open items needed to move client work forward.
  • Coordinate tax-return delivery, electronic signature, e-file authorization, filing, and final document distribution; monitor status across systems and escalate risks before deadlines are affected.
  • Provide administrative support for client payment and tax-agency processes as directed, without interpreting tax law or providing tax advice.

Project & Workflow Coordination

  • Own the administrative movement of client work through the firm’s workflow systems, including promptly marking materials as received, initiating the appropriate projects and workflows, and keeping work moving through each required stage.
  • Monitor project status, deadlines, outstanding information, and next steps; follow up on stalled or overdue items and escalate blockers to the appropriate team member.
  • Manage tasks within Double, including creating, assigning, updating, monitoring, and closing tasks as the platform is implemented across the firm.
  • Maintain accurate project records so team members can quickly identify each project’s current status, responsible party, outstanding needs, and next action.

Client Records, Notion, and Workflow Visibility

  • Own the day-to-day accuracy and upkeep of tax-department client pages and administrative trackers in Notion.
  • Keep client contacts, services, project status, meeting notes, key context, open requests, and next actions current across approved systems.
  • Run routine client-service and tax-administration reports, reconcile discrepancies, and follow up on items that are incomplete or overdue.
  • Document repeatable procedures and maintain usable checklists so work is consistent, transferable, and easy to train.

Relationship Support

  • Maintain a relationship-outreach calendar for birthday messages, milestone acknowledgements, approved client gifts, and other high-touch follow-up.
  • Coordinate approved client communications through Mailchimp or similar tools and keep outreach records current.
  • During lighter periods, prioritize client-record cleanup, proactive outreach, onboarding and offboarding maintenance, process documentation, and other client-service work that improves readiness for the next deadline cycle.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients receive prompt acknowledgement, clear next steps, and professional follow-through.
  • Engagement letters, organizers, document requests, signatures, and delivery steps are completed on time or escalated early.
  • Client pages, trackers, and system records are accurate enough for the team to rely on without detective work.
  • Technical professionals spend less time on administrative follow-up and have the information they need when they need it.
  • Client-service procedures are documented, repeatable, and consistently followed.
  • The firm enters peak periods organized and exits them with records and outstanding items under control.
  • You adapt quickly as the firm grows and systems, processes, and responsibilities evolve, learning new tools and translating change into consistent client-service execution.

Who You Are

  • Service-minded. You make people feel heard, respond promptly, and communicate clearly even when the full answer is not yet available.
  • Detail-oriented. You document decisions, maintain accurate records, and notice missing information before it becomes a deadline problem.
  • Accountable. You own follow-through, use reliable tracking systems, and escalate risks instead of hoping they disappear.
  • Communicative. You are comfortable emailing and calling clients and can translate process steps into plain language.
  • Proactive. You anticipate follow-ups, spot bottlenecks, and act before someone has to chase you.
  • Trustworthy. You handle confidential client and firm information with sound judgment and discretion.
  • Technology-comfortable. You learn new systems quickly and use tools, templates, automation, and AI responsibly to improve your work.
  • Adaptable. You remain calm and organized in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Process-minded. You improve and document repeatable work.
  • Self-directed. You manage priorities, follow established processes, and move work forward with minimal supervision, while using sound judgment to ask questions or escalate issues when needed.

Qualifications

  • Two or more years of experience in client service, administration, project coordination, or a related role.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including confidence speaking directly with clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines, follow-ups, systems, and stakeholders without losing visibility.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel, plus the ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly.
  • Experience with Notion, Missive, SafeSend, Practice CS, QuickBooks Online, tax workflow software, or other professional-services systems is helpful butnot required.
  • Experience in an accounting, legal, financial-services, or other deadline-driven professional-services environment is preferred but not required.
  • Ability to work additional hours as needed during peak periods, typically February through April 15 and September through October 15, with the heaviest demands near filing deadlines.

What This Role Is Not

  • It is not responsible for providing tax advice, answering technical tax questions, or making accounting or tax judgments.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Full time, non-exempt position with a salary of $58,000-68,000 depending upon experience
  • Seattle-area employees may work in-office or on a hybrid schedule. Employees located outside the Seattle area may work fully remote, subject to firm approval and applicable state employment requirements.
  • The firm provides the computer and standard technology equipment needed for the role, including a monitor, keyboard, mouse, headset, and related accessories.
  • Six paid holidays plus four floating holidays (blackout dates during tax/extension season apply)
  • Forty hours of paid sick leave.
  • 15 vacation days per year.
  • Two paid volunteer days each year.
  • Three percent 401(k) retirement match.
  • 100% company-paid premium for Medical (BCBS PPO), vision, and dental (Delta Dental PPO) benefits.

Growth Opportunity

R.D. Barnett PLLC is growing, and what is needed today may be different from what is needed tomorrow. This description is not intended to list every possible activity, duty, or responsibility. Team members who demonstrate strong client judgment, reliable execution, and leadership will have opportunities to expand their responsibilities and grow with the firm.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations.

R.D. Barnett PLLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship or immigration status, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. Applicants who require an accommodation may contact .

title: Product Manager, Optimization
description:
FreeWheel, a Comcast company, provides comprehensive ad platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world.

Job Summary

FreeWheel is looking for a Product Manager to help shape and improve optimization capabilities across the Buyer Cloud platform.

In this role, you’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Revenue and other Product teams to understand customer needs, define product requirements, prioritize investments, and deliver capabilities that help buyers drive stronger performance and business outcomes. You’ll own a defined set of optimization workflows, controls, and product capabilities, helping drive roadmap decisions and execution while contributing to broader product strategy.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration skills, customer empathy, sound product judgment, and the ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, data-driven decision making, and technical considerations.

Job Description

What You’ll Do

  • Own roadmap definition, prioritization, and execution for specific optimization areas within the Buyer Cloud platform.

  • Define and improve workflows, controls, and product capabilities that help customers optimize campaign performance and achieve measurable business outcomes.

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, and Revenue to identify customer problems, evaluate opportunities, and define product requirements.

  • Work with Engineering to balance customer value, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers across Buyer Cloud and adjacent platforms to ensure optimization capabilities fit cohesively into broader user workflows.

  • Gather insights from customers, internal stakeholders, analytics, and market inputs to inform product decisions and prioritization.

  • Write clear product requirements and communicate priorities to cross-functional teams.

  • Make thoughtful tradeoff decisions that balance performance impact, usability, business value, and implementation complexity.

  • Define success metrics and measure outcomes to continuously improve optimization features and customer results.

  • Contribute to product planning and strategy discussions while executing broader organizational priorities.

  • Build strong working relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Customer Success, Operations, and other stakeholder groups.

Who You Are

  • 2–4 years of product management experience building and launching software products.

  • Experience in advertising technology, media technology, or a closely related industry.

  • Demonstrated ability to own features, workflows, or product areas from discovery through delivery.

  • Strong customer empathy and curiosity about how customers make decisions and optimize toward business goals.

  • Experience partnering closely with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Ability to define requirements, prioritize work, and make informed tradeoff decisions.

  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort using data to evaluate opportunities and measure outcomes.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable operating in environments where requirements, priorities, and market needs may evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with optimization products, decisioning systems, controls, or performance-oriented workflows.

  • Familiarity with experimentation, analytics, measurement, or data-informed product development.

  • Exposure to AI or ML-based product management

  • Interest in how AI is changing optimization workflows, decision-making, and customer expectations.

What Makes This Role Different

This role is ideal for a product manager who enjoys solving complex customer problems where usability, control, and measurable outcomes all matter.

You’ll have meaningful ownership of important optimization areas within Buyer Cloud and the opportunity to help customers drive stronger performance through better product experiences, smarter controls, and more effective decision-making.

Rather than focusing only on feature delivery, you’ll work across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Revenue to understand customer problems, evaluate opportunities, and deliver capabilities that create clear business value.

As our platform evolves, you’ll also have opportunities to help shape how emerging capabilities such as AI/ML-based optimization and intelligent bidding fit into the customer journey.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyzing product management activities, defining product concepts, and justifying product-related expenditures
  • Assisting other product managers in solving semi-complex problems and guiding them through larger project initiatives

title: Director, AI Security Science (Remote)
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

The frontier of cybersecurity is being reimagined by AI, and the defenders who win the next decade will be the ones who leverage agents that actually work in the constraints of the environment. We’re looking for an applied research lead to take on both sides (offensive and defensive) of this frontier and help turn it into products.

In this role, you’ll set the scientific direction for our agentic AI work and lead the research behind the next generation of security products. The problems span the full stack: post-training small, efficient models; designing and tuning the harnesses; and developing the evaluation and verification methodologies that give us rigor around if the agents are actually doing what we built them to do. These are open research problems, and we expect the person in this seat to advance the state of the art on them.

This is a player/coach role in the truest sense. You’ll lead teams of strong scientists and engineers, but you’ll also be in the work itself. The successful candidate will bring technical credibility, instincts sharpened by doing the work, and leads by raising the bar on what the team believes is possible.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the research agenda for agentic AI systems that operate autonomously across cybersecurity use cases. Set scientific direction, shaping the team’s research bets and staying close enough to the work to run experiments, review results, and dig into hard problems alongside the team.

  • Drive original research on efficient models tuned for security workflows, including methods in post-training, reward modeling, and data curation strategies that enable them. Personally lead the experimental work on the most ambiguous problems.

  • Establish a rigorous evaluation, verification, and validation methodology covering models, data, agent designs, and end-to-end systems. This includes current and new benchmarks, adversarial evaluation protocols, and measurement practices that others in the field will adopt.

  • Partner closely with security researchers, threat intel, detection engineering, and product to ground applied research in real operator workflows and adversarial conditions.

  • Define principled abstractions for the skills and tools agents use, grounded in practical ways that security agents execute.

  • Advance the science of agent design, including harnesses, scaffolding, planning, memory, tool use, and multi-step reasoning. Contribute novel techniques back to the field through publications and standards.

What You’ll Need:

  • MS or PhD in computer science, computer engineering, or similar quantitative field.

  • 10+ years of experience in data science, ML/DL, or AI with a focus on large-scale data problems.

  • Hands-on expertise in modern LLM post-training techniques.

  • Demonstrated research contributions to or experience building agentic systems.

  • Strong evaluation discipline (designing, extending, or validating methodologies).

  • A leadership style that values hands-on contributions at every level, including your own.

Ways to Stand Out:

  • Hands-on background in offensive security, detection engineering, incident response, or threat intelligence applied research.

  • Experience designing RL environments and synthetic data pipelines for agent tuning.

  • Experience navigating regulatory, compliance, or audit conversations about AI systems, especially translating research into responsible deployment.

  • History of mentoring and growing researchers in the security domain.

title: UX Designer, Octopus
description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

About the Role

Apex is looking for an outstanding UX Designer to research and create the future of Octopus, our proprietary operating system for building spacecraft at scale. Octopus is an integrated suite of engineering, manufacturing, and operations software developed entirely in-house — it links inventory management, production scheduling, quality, and assembly work instructions into a single environment that adjusts dynamically to changing demand. You will be responsible for researching, designing, innovating, and prototyping the experiences that technicians, engineers, planners, and operators depend on every day to build satellites in a way that has never been done before.

Octopus spans the full production lifecycle: part and inventory management, build planning and scheduling, shop-floor work instructions and travelers, non-conformance and quality workflows, supply chain and purchasing, integration and test, and the analytics leadership uses to run the factory. The candidate will be responsible for these internal enterprise tools end to end. Deliverables include design mockups, experience flows, prototyping, design presentations, high-fidelity visuals, and follow-up to ensure high-quality implementation.

Internal software is where manufacturing speed is won or lost. Every extra click, ambiguous screen, and awkward handoff gets multiplied across hundreds of builds and hundreds of people. Your mandate is to make Octopus dramatically better to use: fewer clicks, clearer information hierarchy, workflows that match how the work actually happens, and a set of design standards that keeps the product coherent as it grows. You will collaborate with product managers, software engineers, manufacturing and quality engineers, supply chain, and production leadership as a key contributor and originator. We expect exceptional design skills, creative problem-solving, and a great sense of aesthetics. Octopus should feel fast, information-dense where it needs to be, and unmistakably purpose-built.

What You'll Do

• Research and define UX strategy for Octopus; contribute to the overall product and design direction from concept through implementation

• Spend time on the factory floor and alongside engineering teams to observe real workflows, then translate what you learn into design solutions that serve users from very different backgrounds and with very different requirements

• Relentlessly optimize existing workflows — fewer clicks, fewer screens, fewer opportunities for error — and prove the improvement in task time, error rate, and adoption

• Design for demanding, high-density operating environments: work instructions and travelers, shop-floor terminals and tablets, cleanroom and gloved use, and desk-based planning and analytics tools

• Constantly measure how designs are performing for the people using them; iterate and improve those experiences as needed

• Define, build, and own the Octopus design system, UX standards, and guidelines; advocate for consistency across team members, new modules, and partner teams

• Work in a highly collaborative environment with engineers and other partners; invest in building relationships and trust with stakeholders and leaders

• Present work to partners, stakeholders, and senior leaders regularly

• Follow work through implementation — review builds, catch regressions, and hold the bar on visual and interaction quality

What You'll Bring

• Bachelor's degree in the study of design, or a portfolio that shows equivalent project experience

• 5+ years of experience designing interactive applications for web

• An excellent portfolio showcasing user experience with a strong design sensibility and excellent, user-centric storytelling

• Experience designing enterprise, internal, or operational tools — software where the user is doing a job under time pressure, not browsing

• User-focused, with experience using design research methods such as contextual inquiry, shadowing, and usability testing to uncover insight

• Experience building and maintaining a design system, and defining standards that other designers and engineers actually follow

• Effective written and verbal communication skills

• Self-motivated, able to work independently but also collaborative and driven by group critique

• Ability to perform in a fast-paced, high-intensity iterative design process under minimal supervision

Bonus Points

• Prior experience designing for manufacturing, MES, ERP, logistics, or other operations software

• Comfort working close to code — reading a component library, prototyping in HTML/CSS, or partnering directly in the front-end codebase

• Interest in hardware, aerospace, or physical production environments

This position is for a multi-discipline Senior Hardware Production Support Engineer, capable of solving design and manufacturing problems and providing highly innovative solutions in multiple product assembly, integration, test, statistical process control and transition to production applications. Senior Hardware Production Support Engineers are the liaisons between the design engineers, the factory, and suppliers and are responsible for working with Operations, Supply, Chain, Quality, and other Engineering disciplines to resolve production and transition to production issues.

What You Will Do

  • Enhance your electrical engineering skills working with digital, analog and/or RF hardware testing and debugging complex circuit card assemblies.

  • Collaborate and coordinate with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and other Engineering disciplines to resolve issues that may arise during production, testing, and integration.

  • Lead failure analysis / root cause determination and corrective action implementation.

  • Perform circuit analysis including characterization, modeling and simulation of electrical signals in electronics subsystems.

  • Process Engineering Change Notices and Variances through the Configuration Control Board process.

  • Support the transition to production of new products.

  • Partnering in the development and troubleshooting of test equipment and establishment of test requirements and procedures.

  • This 1st shift role is 100% on-site and will be based in Tewksbury, MA. Frequent travel is to be anticipated between multiple sites including Andover, MA. Infrequent travel to Tucson, AZ will be required, anticipated to be approximately 2 times per year.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Minimum 3+ years experience in testing / troubleshooting RF, analog, digital, and/or mixed signal circuits.

  • The ability to obtain and maintain an Interim Secret U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience in failure analysis / Root-Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations; Preferably with supplier and factory issues.

  • Experience working in a laboratory environment using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, phase noise analyzer (PNA), spectrum analyzers, real time spectrum analyzers, and performance network analyzers to test and verify the functions of digital and RF signal circuits and subsystems.

  • Experience in a production environment.

  • Experience in applying Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods in achieving production yield improvements.

  • Technical writing and formal presentation experience.

  • Active / Existing Secret U.S. Security Clearance.

title: Learning Experience Designer
description:
This position is based in New York, NY

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

The Learning Experience Designer creates high-impact, AI-optimized, modular learning experiences that help LinkedIn customers adopt new behaviors and realize measurable value. This role is ideal for a curious, adaptable builder who is comfortable testing new approaches, learning emerging tools, and iterating quickly as customer needs, products, and priorities evolve. The learning experiences you’ll create will empower customers around the world with the tips, tricks, techniques, and best practices they need to be more productive and successful using LinkedIn tools.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will lead efforts to determine learning objectives, establish clear timelines for deliverables, gather key requirements from partners and product teams, recommend the best format to suit the learner experience, and create learning assets that serve core customer needs. The assets you create will help millions adopt best practices and see tangible value.

You will work in an iterative, feedback-driven environment where priorities and product needs may change quickly. You will be expected to start with enough clarity to move forward, create and test early versions, incorporate feedback, and adjust the solution as new information becomes available. Success requires balancing speed, quality, customer impact, and long-term content sustainability.

To be successful in this role, you must demonstrate critical thinking to solve complex problems within established guidelines, plus innovative techniques to shorten development cycles and meet tight deadlines. You must demonstrate excellent writing skills and be able to adhere to established development guidelines and templates while increasing the effectiveness of learning deliverables. This role also requires thriving in a matrixed environment, working cross-collaboratively with peers to achieve shared goals. Establishing rapport and mutually beneficial relationships with stakeholders is a key to success. Demonstration of self-direction paired with transparent communication is a must.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, prototype, test, and iterate modular learning experiences that help customers take action, adopt priority product behaviors, and realize measurable value from LinkedIn solutions.
  • Script, record, and edit engaging training videos to support product adoption and customer enablement.
  • Partner and build meaningful relationships with key stakeholders and subject matter experts to uncover business and learning needs.
  • Identify learning objectives tied to desired customer adoption and behavior outcomes.
  • Design training assets and recommend the learning modality while balancing tight timelines, continuous product changes, and strengthened learning catalog performance.
  • Provide graphic design support for assets and experiences published in the virtual learning center.
  • Seek feedback early and often, using it to test assumptions, improve the solution, and establish practical standards for future content builds.
  • Innovate and develop agentic workflow augmentations that leverage artificial intelligence to increase the quality of and reduce time to market for modular, digital learning content.
  • Meet all deliverable deadlines.

The Instructional Designer creates high-impact, AI-optimized, modular learning experiences that help LinkedIn customers adopt new behaviors and realize measurable value. This role is ideal for a curious, adaptable builder who is comfortable testing new approaches, learning emerging tools, and iterating quickly as customer needs, products, and priorities evolve.

Seek feedback early and often, using it to test assumptions, improve the solution, and establish practical standards for future content builds.

Demonstrated ability to apply instructional, visual, and multimedia design principles to create concise, engaging learning experiences.

Experience identifying and implementing improvements to content-development processes, standards, or workflows.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply instructional, visual, and multimedia design principles to create concise, engaging learning experiences.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and learning agility, including a willingness to test unfamiliar tools, request feedback, and adjust an approach based on what is learned.
  • Experience identifying and implementing improvements to content-development processes, standards, or workflows.
  • BA or equivalent work experience.

description:
The Opportunity:

Adobe Firefly is transforming how creators ideate, create, and express themselves through generative AI. As Firefly continues to scale, data-driven growth and high-quality experimentation are core to how we learn, prioritize, and deliver value to millions of users.

This hybrid role mixes hands-on analytical tasks with strategic leadership as you build and expand a team during rapid growth. You will work closely with Firefly Product, Leadership, PMM, GTM, PLG, and Engineering teams. You will also collaborate with participants across the organization to influence strategy, roadmap, and investment decisions throughout the customer lifecycle. Your duties include developing insights that guide product and business choices and creating data science models.

If you are passionate about AI and creativity, data-driven decision-making, systems, and design thinking, and thrive in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply. Join our team to shape the future of digital creativity with Adobe's generative AI. This opportunity lets you reach millions of creatives and help them change how they work.

What you’ll do:

  • Play a hands-on analytical role during your first few months. Then, transition to managing, mentoring, and leading a team of data analysts and scientists. You will ensure high-quality work, clear growth paths for team members, and balanced resourcing across workstreams.

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our customers, products, and business performance to inform data-driven decisions

  • Function as a trusted advisor for counterparts on Product, Marketing, GTM, PLG, and Engineering teams to guide the roadmap by providing data-driven insights and proposals

  • Partner with senior and executive leadership to shape Firefly's analytics and experimentation strategy

  • Anticipate risks and roadblocks before they surface, and proactively define and prioritize the opportunities most worth pursuing to grow the business

  • Define important measurements and lead monitoring of these to assess product performance and track product health

  • Partner with multi-functional partners and the analytics product manager to develop and complete a roadmap of analytics initiatives. These initiatives will drive the most business value for the suite of Firefly products the team manages.

  • Perform advanced deep dives, build predictive models and dashboards to mine insights

  • Combine data, experimentation, and insights based on detailed examination to deliver actionable recommendations that address opportunities for product improvements

  • Improve reporting and data tools to empower data-driven decision-making in the workstreams you support

What you’ll need to succeed:

Required:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in an analytical field: statistics, applied mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics, physics etc. or equivalent practical experience

  • Over 4 years of experience leading analytics & data science groups, including mentoring senior individual contributors

  • 5+ years of proficiency in Python and SQL

  • Strong proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL-like languages on cloud (Databricks, Spark-SQL, Airflow)

  • Strong fundamentals in statistics as well as shown skills in data visualizations

  • Experience with A/B testing and sampling methods

  • Good communication and relationship building skills

Preferred / nice-to-have:

  • A track record spanning over 3 years in contemporary data science processes in cloud environments (Git, Jupyter, Python, AWS, Azure)

  • Ability to support multiple ongoing projects in a fast-paced environment

  • Solid background in data warehousing, data modeling, data access, and data storage techniques

  • Experience crafting dashboards in Tableau or PowerBI

  • Expert in one or more data science tools such as Pandas, NumPy etc

  • Experience with Adobe Analytics or a similar web analytics tool

  • Experience building data processing machine learning models in a product environment

  • Familiarity with ML for propensity estimation and causal inference with observational data or experimental designs

  • Merchandise discounts

  • Resourceful and able to adapt quickly to changing priorities and deadlines

Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Our Marketing, Sales & Service organization advances Ford’s reputation as a visionary vehicle and mobility services company and helps deliver a trusted customer experience. Use your marketing, sales, and service expertise to turn data-driven insights into innovative solutions that enhance sales and customer loyalty. Join us and be the eyes, ears, and voice of Ford.

The Yield Management (YM) team supports all Ford Blue, Model e, and Ford Pro product lines and tackles the ~5 highest priority strategic and profit projects each quarter. The team works in “Value Sprints” with a dedicated team focused against a specific mandate for a dedicated period of time. The team applies problem-solving framework and leverages advanced analytics to derive insights and deliver tangible recommendations to create value for Ford. Yield Management’s project portfolio aims to deliver a balance of:

  • Near term vehicle line specific profit improvement or risk mitigation actions
  • New or expanded enterprise capabilities
  • Long term portfolio optimizations


This Yield Management position operates cross-functionally across Marketing & Sales, Brand, Product Marketing, General Management, GDI&A, Finance, & Ford Credit. Data Scientists come from a range of different backgrounds and work on specific “sprints” typically for 6-8 weeks.

In this position…

This role is at the intersection of strategy, operations, and analytics, and is tasked with creating change and maximizing profits in the Ford+ plan. The immediate working team is highly collaborative and fast-paced. This is a high-exposure role with ongoing interaction with leadership across Ford Blue, Model e, and Ford Pro.

As a Data Scientist, you will perform analysis and modeling as part of Yield Management Scope: Profit optimization & decision analysis, vehicle line demand estimation, price sensitivity analysis, counter-factual modeling, and hypothesis testing.

What you'll do...

In sprints, Data Scientists are responsible for:

  • Accessing and analyzing data to develop solutions, including leveraging advanced analytics tools and building ad-hoc data models
  • Applying structured problem-solving mindset to sprints
  • Considering enterprise-wide impact and sensitivity of sprint recommendations
  • Communicating analysis insights and implications of sprint recommendations
  • Apply and integrate latest analytical tools developed by Yield Management Advanced Analytics modeling team
  • Assist in preparing presentations and reports for management and business customers

Additionally, Data Scientists support:

  • Establishing the sprint mandate and problem statement with key stakeholders
  • Leading analysis and developing insights and implications of decisions
  • Delivering clear and actionable recommendations

You'll have...

title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Amazon Leo OISL
description:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to help architect and build a ground-based optical communication system that enables high-speed data transfer between satellites and ground stations. This role sits at the intersection of embedded systems, networking, cloud infrastructure, and remote operations, and requires a versatile engineer who can work across the full stack from hardware-adjacent firmware to cloud-based orchestration and remote monitoring.

You will own the design and implementation of software systems that control, monitor, and manage optical ground terminals, including real-time device control, network integration, remote management, and cloud-based operations infrastructure. This is a greenfield opportunity to shape the architecture of a critical system from the ground up.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Architect and develop software for ground-based optical communication terminals, spanning embedded control systems, networking stacks, and cloud infrastructure.

Design and implement remote management and monitoring systems for geographically distributed ground terminal deployments.

Develop networking solutions for high-throughput optical data paths, including integration with broader network infrastructure.

Build cloud-based operations platforms for fleet management, telemetry, alarming, and performance monitoring.

Design and implement infrastructure-as-code for automated deployment, configuration management, and scaling of ground systems.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including optical, electrical, firmware, mechanical, and systems engineers.

Define system architecture, interfaces, and protocols for ground terminal software subsystems.

Develop fault-tolerant, highly available systems capable of autonomous operation in remote environments.

Own full lifecycle delivery from requirements through deployment and ongoing operations.

A day in the life
As a Software Engineer on the Optical Inter-Satellite Link team, you won't just write code - you'll see it in action. Your software will control and monitor high-speed laser communications between ground and satellites that moving at orbital velocities, and you'll be there for every stage of the journey: from early design and on-the-ground verifications to watching your code enable high throughput commuications.

About the team
You will join a multi-disciplinary team of top-notch engineers whose work spans an unusually wide aperture: embedded flight software running on satellites in orbit, cloud-based systems powering mission and network operations, automation frameworks that keep a growing constellation healthy, and AI-driven capabilities that make our optical links smarter with every orbit. We collaborate closely with optical, electrical, firmware, opto-mechanical, and operations teams — and with partner organizations including Mission Operations and Optical Network Operations — to deliver one of the most advanced optical communication systems ever built.

KBR’s Mission Engineering Division delivers complex technical solutions and expert support to the U.S. Department of War, specializing in modeling and simulation, cyber transformation, air vehicle mission integration, and lifecycle support. As a trusted partner with a proven history in mission technology, KBR collaborates closely with clients to develop innovative and effective solutions. Job Summary

KBR Mission Technology Solutions is seeking a motivated and talented System of Systems Engineer to join our team in Lexington Park, MD. Fundamentally, systems engineers solve problems, often by combining traditionally disparate methods into new, creative solutions. The selectee will contribute to the design, development, implementation, integration, testing and delivery of multidisciplinary, cross-platform hardware and software solutions for the Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR).

Fire Control Experience: Experience within the integration of platforms, sensors, and weapons across Navy kill chains.

Amentum is seeking a CNC Machine Repair Supervisor in Durham, NC.

Typical work schedule is Monday - Friday, 6:30 am – 3:00 pm; hours may vary based on business demand. Weekend and call-in support as needed.

This position will Supervise a team of 5 -14 employees supporting technical operations at the client’s facility. The scope of service includes the maintaining, development, execution, and continuously improving the preventative and predictive maintenance activities at the client’s site. The equipment included in the scope is:

  • Multi-Axis Wet and Dry Grinders

  • Balancers

  • Central Coolant Systems

  • Pumps and Exhaust systems

  • HVAC Units

  • Hydraulic and electrical systems

  • Robotic Tool Changers

The Supervisor is responsible for technical support, direction, safety training, audits and quality control for Amentum facility, production and/or contract employees in a fast-paced industrial production environment.

This Supervisor will also be able to perform as the technical expert with respect to installing, troubleshooting, servicing, and documenting the electrical/electronic, mechanical and controls needs of automated equipment in an industrial environment. Maintains, improves, and troubleshoots, Machine Tools, Automated and CNC Machines with PLC and distribute I/O control systems such as Allen Bradley, Siemens 7, GE, Emerson, Reliance, Omron, Ceda, Honeywell and related controllers. Must be well versed in robots and robotic control systems such as Fanuc, ABB, Mazatrol Kuka, Yaskawa, Kawasaki, Denso, and Mitsubishi. Must be fluent working with instrumentation such as thermocouples; RTDs and pressure, flow, position, and level transducers; and associated equipment and techniques. Works with voltage from control (12-24V) through medium voltage motor controls 480 volts, 3 phase.

This position provides instructions and mentors and trains less skilled technicians as required. Must be an effective communicator with team, site management, vendors, and customers. This position will lead small to large repairs, overhauls, and construction projects with minimal supervision.

The Machine Tool Supervisor must have the ability to identify troubleshoot and correct any operational or safety-related issues and perform independent equipment root cause evaluations to identify potential equipment failures. Identifies and documents cost savings.

The Supervisor is responsible for the prioritization of work based on the needs of the client and for the on-time completion of all work, as well as all documentation involved. Provides and / or schedules needed training and cross-training for multi-functional employees. Implement all safety rules and guidelines for all Amentum employees. This includes but is not limited to; opportunities for improved asset reliability, improved quality results, safer work conditions, and lower maintenance costs, improved work plans to increase efficiency.

title: Volunteer Role- Therapeutic Use Exemption Committee (TUEC) Member
description:
FRENCH TO FOLLOW

Therapeutic Use Exemption Committee (TUEC) Member

Sport Integrity Canada is seeking individuals to fill the volunteer opportunity of Therapeutic Use Exemption Committee (TUEC) Member on an ongoing volunteer basis. The TUEC has a key role in implementing the Canadian Anti-Doping Program (CADP) by reviewing and evaluating athletes’ applications for Therapeutic Use Exemptions (TUE), which allow an athlete with a medical condition to use substances or methods that are otherwise prohibited in sport through their inclusion on the World Anti-Doping Agency’s (WADA) Prohibited List. The TUEC follows WADA’s International Standard for Therapeutic Use Exemptions (ISTUE) to determine if a TUE should be granted.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Therapeutic Use Exemption Committee Member

Key Responsibilities

  • Review Applications: Evaluate and make determinations on TUE applications from athletes, ensuring adherence to the ISTUE and its guidelines, as appropriate.
  • Decision Making: Use professional judgement to provide unbiased opinions and make impartial decisions in the best interest of athletes, sport, and the organization.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with fellow TUEC members and liaise effectively with other stakeholders.
  • Adherence: Uphold Sport Integrity Canada values, principles, and policies while maintaining confidentiality and following technical procedures as per the ISTUE.

TUEC MEMBER PROFILE

Required Qualifications:

  • Medical Degree: M.D. or equivalent qualification.
  • Professional Experience: Demonstrated experience in sport medicine or related fields.
  • Expertise: Specialists in psychiatry (ADHD/ADD), pain management, cardiology, or general sports medicine.
  • Integrity: Impeccable ethical standards and confidentiality

Desired Skills:

  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are required; French language skills are an asset.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to analyze complex cases and apply logical reasoning.
  • Detail Oriented: Ability to follow protocols and procedures with precision.
  • Confidentiality: Proven track record of managing sensitive information with discretion

POSITION DETAILS

  • Commitment: Review two to three TUE applications per month, with flexibility depending on application volume and specialty.
  • Meetings: Attend biannual TUEC meetings, which may be virtual or in person.
  • Location: Remote
  • Remuneration: The Sport Integrity Canada TUEC is composed of volunteers; no remuneration is provided.

Interested applicants can submit their applications electronically Applications should include a cover letter and resumé.

We thank all applicants for their interest but only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. For more information about Sport Integrity Canada, please visit

Throughout its recruitment process, Sport Integrity Canada is committed to Canada’s linguistic duality and diversity of its people. We welcome expressions of interest from all qualified applicants including Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, members of visible minority groups, and all gender identities and sexual orientations. Upon request, accommodations will be provided during the hiring process.

Membre du Comité pour l’autorisation d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques (CAUT)

Sport Intégrité Canada est à la recherche de personnes désireuses de se joindre, à titre bénévole et sur une base continue, à son Comité pour l’autorisation d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques (CAUT).

Le CAUT contribue au Programme canadien antidopage (PCA) en traitant les demandes d’autorisation d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques (AUT), soumises par les athlètes dont l’état de santé nécessite l’utilisation de substances ou de méthodes figurant sur la Liste des interdictions de l’Agence mondiale antidopage (AMA). Le CAUT base ses décisions sur le Standard international pour les autorisations d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques (SIAUT) de l’AMA. Sport Intégrité Canada travaille de façon collaborative afin que les Canadiens vivent des expériences sportives positives. Par ses programmes, le CCES s’attaque aux problèmes d’éthique dans le sport, protège l’intégrité du sport canadien et fait la promotion de Sport pur pour activer le sport axé sur des valeurs, sur le terrain et à l’extérieur. Sport Intégrité Canada est l’organisme national indépendant et à but non lucratif responsable de l’administration du PCA.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Membre du Comité pour l’autorisation d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques

DÉTAILS DU POSTE

Responsabilités principales

  • Analyse des demandes : évaluer les demandes d’AUT des athlètes conformément au SIAUT et à ses lignes directrices.
  • Prise de décisions : juger les demandes d’AUT de manière avisée, professionnelle et impartiale, le tout dans l’intérêt des athlètes, du sport et de l’organisme.
  • Collaboration : travailler de concert avec les autres membres du CAUT et communiquer efficacement avec les intervenants.
  • Conformité : observer les valeurs, principes et politiques du Sport Intégrité Canada tout en maintenant la confidentialité et en suivant la procédure technique prévue par le SIAUT.

PROFIL

Exigences

  • Diplôme en médecine : M.D. ou formation équivalente.
  • Expérience professionnelle : expérience avérée en médecine sportive ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Expertise : psychiatrie (TDAH/TDA), gestion de la douleur, cardiologie ou médecine sportive générale.
  • Intégrité : rigueur éthique et confidentialité irréprochables.

Compétences

  • Communication : excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite en anglais (en français, un atout).
  • Raisonnement analytique : capacité à analyser des cas complexes selon un raisonnement logique.
  • Souci du détail : suivre les protocoles et procédures à la lettre.
  • Confidentialité : capacité éprouvée à gérer de l’information sensible avec discrétion.

DÉTAILS DU POSTE

Engagement : traiter entre deux et trois demandes d’AUT par mois (la charge de travail peut varier selon le nombre et la particularité des demandes reçues).

Réunions : participer aux réunions semestrielles (virtuelles ou en personne) du CAUT.

Lieu : télétravail.

title: Lab Systems Engineer, Silicon Bring-Up & Automation Platforms
description:
In this highly visible role, you will bring up and validate new Apple Silicon at the bench while building the internal software platforms the broader hardware and lab organization relies on daily. At Apple, we work every day to craft products that enrich people’s lives and as part of an extremely dynamic, forward-thinking team, you’ll have the rare opportunity to build nuanced tools that help delight millions of Apple’s customers. If you love debugging silicon that has never run before, tackling challenges no one has solved yet, and automating tasks that span multiple continents, building the tools that make everyone else’s debug faster, this is the role for you.

In this role, you will bring up and validate new Apple Silicon at the bench, debugging silicon that has never run before and tackling hardware issues as they surface in the lab. Alongside this hands-on validation work, you'll develop methods to improve and automate the collection, storage, processing, and visualization of silicon validation data from labs worldwide. You’ll build and deploy scalable data pipelines using scheduling systems and design infrastructure to support distributed validation across bare metal macOS, Docker, and Kubernetes environments. You will also automate the setup of silicon validation environments and manage data migration across systems. A part of the role includes instrument tracking and network automation—integrating with lab hardware to configure devices, manage network environments, monitor instrument status, and collect validation data securely and at scale. For efficient and insightful data analytics, you’ll build AI/ML based tools that accelerate data analysis and integrate with existing data analysis platforms. This includes tracking power utilization of lab equipment, identifying patterns in usage, and optimizing for future demand through predictive modeling. This work involves close collaboration with hardware, software, and infrastructure teams to enable rapid data exploration, debug large-scale systems, and implement alerting mechanisms that enhance observability and transparency across automation workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 3+ years of experience
  • Strong Python fundamentals, proven ability to build production-quality internal tools, APIs, and services
  • Proven collaborator across teams, with clarity, ownership, and timely communication
  • Familiarity with databases (SQL/NoSQL), file systems, and object storage
  • Direct experience with silicon bring-up or hardware validation, including register-level debug
  • Experience with Docker and deploying/operating Kubernetes-based infrastructure for lab or validation services, CI/CD pipelines and version control systems
  • Hands-on experience with lab/test instrumentation (scopes, logic analyzers, power analyzers) and instrument automation
  • Experience automating network configuration and diagnostics for lab environments
  • Experience maintaining shared internal instrumentation/automation libraries
  • Experience with device/fleet monitoring systems (topology, MAC/port tracking, calibration tracking)
  • Experience with AI-assisted development, plugins, custom skills/agents, or agentic workflows
  • Experience developing, deploying, and maintaining applied ML or statistical modeling pipelines to analyze lab and system data at scale
  • Experience implementing alerting and monitoring systems for workflow health and failure detection
  • Prior experience publishing papers, posters, or other technical work in relevant conferences or venues
